entries.080d9cd5d10c270b: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥529,660 thousand (up 59.6% year on year), with an operating margin of 6.0%; ordinary profit was ¥525,873 thousand, and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥307,771 thousand. Segment profit (on an operating profit basis) of the reportable segments was ¥1,136,464 thousand for the Communication Business. The Solutions Business recorded a segment loss of ¥34,489 thousand, and the Investment and Incubation Business recorded a segment loss of ¥17,462 thousand. The increase in cost of sales was mainly due to an increase in purchases from mobile network operators, accompanying the rise in the number of domestic SMS deliveries.

entries.20cef3f0370c0089: A business in which Forward Edge-AI Japan Co., Ltd. (the Company's voting rights ownership ratio: 60%), a joint venture with Forward Edge-AI, Inc. of the United States, implements next-generation security technologies in society in Japan, including PQC (post-quantum cryptography), which is intended to address the risk of encryption being broken in the era of quantum computers.
entries.3e4ee7dbc8f25df7: SMS delivery services provided by the company in Japan. The company also offers SNS-based messaging services such as LINE Mini Apps. In Japan, the average selling price continues to fall due to price competition with competitors, but the number of SMS messages delivered is increasing. Going forward, the company plans to make use of its advantage in the number of messages delivered in the SMS market to expand its business into SNS-based messages as well and to grow revenue.
entries.3fa19239d8e19a87: Messaging services provided by the Vietnamese subsidiary VietGuys J.S.C. (the company's voting rights ownership ratio: 51%, Ho Chi Minh City). In the fiscal year ended December 2025, diversification away from dependence on SMS advanced, with OTT (messages sent over the internet), various solutions and reward businesses growing, greatly changing the composition of sales. From 2026 onward, the company plans to shift to a strategy of building an integrated ecosystem based on industry-specific know-how and having customers use multiple services at the same time. This company's sales (excluding internal sales between consolidated companies) were ¥1,655,053 thousand, and it is a specified subsidiary accounting for more than 10% of consolidated sales.
entries.470b59518f13abaf: A segment that invests in promising development-focused and AI ventures and aims to take them in as business revenue, while using them internally at the Company and providing support to grow the invested companies' businesses (incubation). It also has the role of creating business synergies through cooperation among Group companies. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue including inter-segment internal sales was ¥1,182,453 thousand (up 751.9% year on year), and the segment loss (operating profit basis) was ¥17,462 thousand. Revenue increased substantially due to the effect of Zuno Media Solutions Co., Ltd., Zuno Co., Ltd. and Forglobe Co., Ltd. newly joining the scope of consolidation, but some businesses have not yet reached full-scale operation.

entries.5e71c541b88d1084: Email delivery services provided by the domestic subsidiary Technomix Co., Ltd. It offers "Gakko Anshin Mail," which makes communication among schools, PTAs and parents smoother, and "Jichitai Anshin Mail," an emergency contact system for crime prevention and disaster-prevention crisis management between residents and local governments. Because the declining birthrate is reducing the number of students covered and the number of messages delivered tends to fall, the company is strengthening cooperation with sales agents and focusing on expanding its customer base.

entries.7f465ad581ae7e90: Products that use voice and facial image analysis technology. They consist of three products: Video Analytics, Voice Analytics and Digital Footprint, and are used for "Health Assessment" (measuring an individual's physical and mental health condition), "HR Assessment" (analyzing aptitude for work) and "Credit Risk Assessment" (measuring an individual's credit risk). Through the provision of customization services for BtoB and the opening of an online sales site, the company is putting in place a structure for expanding its sales channels.

entries.862d042f8743dc26: The company and 7 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] mainly engage in the messaging services business, including SMS. Its 3 [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are the Communication Business, the Solutions Business and the Investment and Incubation Business. Under its Medium-Term Management Plan [2025-2027], it has set the goal of moving beyond a single SMS business and is advancing the commercialization of new AI and security solutions. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,791,215 thousand, and revenue by reportable segment, including intersegment internal revenue, was ¥6,515,895 thousand for the Communication Business, ¥1,205,356 thousand for the Solutions Business and ¥1,182,453 thousand for the Investment and Incubation Business.
entries.867b76afb1a3aedb: The group's main business, in which the company and its subsidiaries provide messaging services, including the delivery of SMS (mobile phone short messages). The company started its SMS delivery business for corporate customers in 2010 and provides services to more than 5,300 companies. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales including internal sales between segments were ¥6,515,895 thousand (up 12.2% year on year) and segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥1,136,464 thousand (up 88.1% year on year), with the number of SMS messages delivered both in Japan and via overseas aggregators increasing. 29.9% of consolidated sales came from SMS delivery services via overseas aggregators, and their trends are regarded as a factor with a significant impact on operating results. Contractual relationships with mobile carriers are likewise an important factor. In Japan, the average selling price continues to fall due to price competition with competitors.
entries.87ba2d61b2298957: A segment that invests in promising development-focused and AI ventures and aims to take them in as business revenue, while using them internally at the Company and providing support to grow the invested companies' businesses (incubation).
entries.8a88a9b289a70ac5: A business centered on "SchooMy," an IoT edge device for school education. The company is expanding its network of sales agents for high schools and aims to increase new learning areas and business models through cooperation with compulsory education, universities and local governments. From the fourth quarter consolidated accounting period of the fiscal year ended December 2025, part of the sales function was transferred to Technomix, which operates its business for elementary and junior high schools, and adoption through local governments is being promoted using its sales network.

entries.c5b0ea97ca365030: A new segment announced in the Medium-Term Management Plan (2025-2027), in which the company develops and commercializes its own solutions, centered on the fields of AI and security. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales including internal sales between segments were ¥1,205,356 thousand (up 170.6% year on year) and the segment loss (operating profit basis) was ¥34,489 thousand. The increase in sales was due to the accumulation of sales from transactions with container data center operators in the GPU server-related business, and some businesses have not yet reached full-scale operation. Getworks Co., Ltd., which accounted for 13.50% of total sales results in the fiscal year ended December 2025, is cited in the securities report as a customer related to this segment.
entries.c93fffbf96be4806: A business related to GPU servers. The policy is to expand the field through collaboration and cooperation between the Group and outside companies.
entries.d10221094b9257fa: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,791,215 thousand (up 38.5% year on year). In Japan, unit selling prices have continued to fall amid price competition with rivals, but the number of SMS deliveries both domestically and via overseas aggregators increased. In the Solutions Business and the Investment and Incubation Business, some businesses have not yet reached full-scale operation.
